character: Thermal spa town at valley floor (600m). Access to 3 Vallées via Orelle gondola (20 min). Grand Hôtel des Thermes. Thermal baths and spa. Casino. Belle Époque architecture. Ski via funicular to Orelle. Good for non-skiers.
dining: Thermal cuisine. Village restaurants, salons de thé.
shopping: Pharmacy, bakery, spa products, convenience stores.
activities_nearby: Thermes de Brides (thermal spa, cures, wellness). Casino Joa. Tennis, golf, hiking. Orelle gondola to 3 Vallées (20 min).
